source_version: Theory of Computing15(2019),Article2; final publisher source September7,2019
title: Tight expected-amortized cell-probe time lower bound for streaming Hamming distance

standard_prerequisites.name: Entropy, randomized cell-probe model and elementary coding theory
standard_prerequisites.statement: Original model definitions, cited information-transfer encoding lemma and complete new hard-string/vector-code construction retained.
standard_prerequisites.use: No collector reproof; no worst-case or zero-error strengthening of the author expected-amortized theorem.

core_obligations: The authors encode large families of distinct Hamming output arrays using vector multisets and cyclic constant-weight codes, then place copies of a hard pattern across exponentially separated stream alignments. Complete many-distinct-sums construction, entropy accounting and information-transfer charging proof are retained. The original expected-amortized randomized cell-probe lower bound and delta=min(log q,log n) convention are preserved.
